record_type: Historical measurements before source packaging; not rerun for this export

exported_service_profile.pipeline: Native vision processing + EAGLE3 K4 + draft INT8 top-1 + synchronous FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs

page_comparison.scope: Layout and VLM share one A100 per arm. Includes local HTTP, layout, VLM, Markdown and JSON; excludes model startup, platform download and result reporting. The two arms used separate same-model A100s.

historical_research_crop_profile.reason: Also used experimental preprocessing/vision/grouped-loop optimizations; its speed must not be attributed to the exported HTTP service.
historical_research_crop_profile.scope: Warm single-crop, batch=1, end-to-end on one A100 using greedy decoding. Layout, page postprocessing, network, image disk I/O and engine startup excluded.

claims_limit: These measurements do not establish 2x full-page performance or exact equivalence for all future inputs/hardware.
